data.name: Navtorio
data.detailed_description:
Navtorio is a realistic orienteering game built with next-generation graphics. The game focuses on navigation and precise map reading in complex environments.

Disciplins 

  • Sprint in urban environments such as city centers, residential areas, and parks. This discipline focuses on high speed and rapid decision-making on paved surfaces.

  • Indoor in large, multi-story complexes like universities, shopping malls and offices. This discipline focuses on vertical navigation, requiring you to interpret floor plans and utilize stairwells to navigate between levels.


Multiplayer
Compete directly against your friends or other players online. Race in real-time to see who combines map reading and navigating best.

Post-Race Analytics
Review your performance after the race. The analytics tool allows you to replay your run, compare your route against the calculated optimal path, and see exactly where you lost time compared to opponents.

Course Creator
Create your own and play others courses. You can place control points and set up artificial barriers to block paths and change the route choices.

data.short_description: A competitive orienteering game featuring Sprint and Indoor disciplines. Race against friends in multiplayer, analyze your route choices with post-race analytics, and design your own courses by placing barriers and checkpoints on photorealistic maps.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
